intermediate.name: Puerto Los Madroños
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Puerto Los Madroños (126.6 km)

story: A four-rider breakaway formed early, with Lidl–Trek and NSN controlling the gap from the peloton. One of the day’s favourites, Mads Pedersen, crashed out of the race. A sharp acceleration over the day’s only categorised climb briefly split the bunch, with Almeida missing the front group. Pellizzari attacked late but was caught, before Girmay won the sprint to claim his first victory for his new team.
